text:
Winnipeg arrives in Tampa winless in six (0-4-2) after a 5-1 loss to Florida on Monday, outscored 19-10 over that stretch. Josh Morrissey and Vladislav Namestnikov are out, and with Morrissey gone Neal Pionk has jumped to 25:20 a night and the first power-play unit. Tampa Bay is 3-1-1 in its last five but dropped a 5-4 overtime game at Utah, where Dmitri Simashev scored his first NHL goal to win it after the Mammoth came back from two down. Victor Hedman is day-to-day and could return.

Our numbers favor the Lightning, with an expected 3.41 goals to Winnipeg's 2.75. At five on five, TBL has taken 56% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) in its games, WPG 47%, and the Jets allow 3.35 expected goals per 60 to Tampa's 2.86. Both power plays are modest, though the Lightning's penalty kill gives up less. In net, projected starter Stuart Skinner is +6.1 goals saved above expected this season, while Andrei Vasilevskiy is at -0.9 despite +23.2 last year.

Watch Kyle Connor (43% to score, 70% for a point) and, for Tampa, Brandon Hagel (44%) and Nikita Kucherov, who just became the franchise's all-time points leader and sits at 81% for a point. Our under-the-radar picks: Cole Perfetti, 52% for a point because his line creates chances, and Pontus Holmberg, a third-liner with dangerous shots lately and a 17% shot at a goal.
